title: Spreading and dilution of the saline subtropical water
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 monthly temperature, salinity, velocity, sea surface height and mixed-layer thickness for 2011-2020 in the western Tasman Sea off south-eastern Australia (46-26 S, 147-162 E), trace the saline subtropical water that the East Australian Current carries south: where its salinity maximum lies in depth, how its core salinity changes along the path, through the seasons and from year to year, and what dilutes it.

region.name: Tasman Sea and East Australian Current
